brief:
Mehdi traveled to Houston for a live conversation with award-winning comedian Mo Amer, according to Zeteo. The discussion centered on Amer's Netflix series and what he described as the "immense responsibility" of telling Palestinian stories through his work in comedy and television.

The live interview also touched on Amer's broader career, including references to entertainment figures like DJ Khaled, as the comedian reflected on his platform and creative approach to depicting Palestinian narratives on screen.
dek: Mehdi traveled to Texas for a live WNK with the award-winning comedian, discussing his hit Netflix series and the “immense responsibility” of telling Palestinian stories.
title: Comedian Mo Amer discusses Palestine storytelling on Netflix in Houston interview
